name: @schema-pop/importer
description: Unified CLI dispatcher: schema-pop-import <file> picks tree-sitter (Rust) or system clang (C / C++) and writes an arktype scope.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --packages external && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --noEmit false
